source.text: An Adidas-style campaign showing me getting ready before a big game. Cinematic and premium.

composition.summary: Close, deliberate frames of preparation, with room around the subject for a premium feel.

camera.summary: Close-ups and medium shots with slow, controlled movement.

lighting.summary: Low-key, directional light with a rim to separate her from a dark room.

color.summary: A restrained, premium palette: deep neutrals, little saturation.

environment.summary: A locker room before a big game.

subject_placement.summary: Her alone, the centre of every frame.

motion.summary: Small preparation gestures, like lacing boots and a last breath.

editing_rhythm.summary: Measured cuts that build toward the walk out.
